name: Spatial Bento
promise: The whole portfolio as one composed field of tiles, each a different kind of object, its own index an isometric plane of every board.
description: A bento document. The first view is one field the height of the window: the hero plate with the practice thesis, the Contents tile that indexes the page as isometric planes of its boards, the dated Now note, a ledger of figures, the leading works as media tiles, and how to reach the owner. Five boards follow, each opened by a label on the ground, every section a tile shaped by what it holds. Every title, description, link, work, case study, and action is selectable HTML. On a device that meets the stage's capability policy, a bounded spatial stage draws over the Contents tile's still, with an exit, and any failure tears it down to the still.

sources.source: The bento and spatial lineages the scope names for Spatial Bento
sources.note: The composed tile field, its index as planes of its boards, and a bounded stage that only adds to them.
